body:
B5-18b (Camera Raw viewport preview) is ready for review: origin/wp/B5-18b at 117b44f8, based on dd2cf300. Commits: f0bd139d (Rust and tests), 117b44f8 (Swift, bindings, HANDOFF). Only document/filters.rs changed on the Rust side; no engine crates.

- Previews: camera_raw no longer forces a full-canvas level-0 render.
  - A new camera_raw_halo() classifies the settings.
  - Local settings (WB, tone, curves, HSL, detail, texture/clarity) render the viewport plus a halo at view resolution, via the existing viewport preview path.
  - Whole-image settings (lens/CA, dehaze, vignette, grain, lens blur, geometry, masks) render the whole canvas at the view level.
  - Smart-filter validation runs on a level of at most 256K pixels.
- Behavior change: the sheet default now turns lens-profile and CA correction OFF, matching Photoshop's Camera Raw Filter for non-raw input. Before, they ran silently with no Optics UI.
- Re-edit double-apply: a new FFI smart_filter_detail replaces the saved filter instead of stacking on it. Both the Camera Raw sheet and the generic filter sheet use it.
- Detail pane: filter_detail now writes sRGB-encoded pixels to match its tag. That affects ALL filters and matches the canvas.
- Spec::name returns "Camera Raw Filter"; the Swift mapping is removed.

Numbers on 24 MP, warm:
| case | before | after |
| fit-view preview, local | 9.4 s, 3.7 GB | 0.45 s, 219 MB |
| detail pane | 9.1 s | 36 ms |
| 100% preview, local | 8.4 s | 0.61 s |
| 100% preview, vignette | unchanged | 5.4 s (still the whole canvas) |
| apply | full resolution, same path | same |
Tests assert on developed pixels and allocations, not timing.

Gates:
- tessera-ffi release: 500 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy and fmt: clean.
- swift-gate: SWIFT GATE OK, 776 tests.
- make-app and codesign: OK.

Open engine asks:
- a region path in the Develop renderer, for whole-image settings at 100%;
- the full-size proxy that every filter preview allocates, which is the compositor's.

Self-test: --camera-raw-selftest under --nonactivating opened no window, so it never ran. That makes four packages hitting this: channel-paint, vector, camera-raw, and transform, which 12b fixed locally. B is now building ONE shared fix for every document self-test: a background, never-key document window under --nonactivating, replacing 12b's local copy. It'll be on a new branch wp/B5-selftest-window for your review. Your on-screen runners benefit too.
